subtitle.en: Go · LLM · Tool-Calling · Streaming · Mock Implementation
subtitle.pt: Go · LLM · Tool-Calling · Streaming · Mock Implementation

description.en: Go-based LLM agent framework with a provider-agnostic interface, tool-calling agent loop, and MockLLM for testing without API keys. Supports streaming via iterator pattern, with CI pipeline via GitHub Actions.
description.pt: Framework de agentes LLM em Go com interface agnóstica de provedor, loop de agente com chamada de ferramentas e MockLLM para testes sem chaves de API. Suporta streaming via padrão iterator, com pipeline CI via GitHub Actions.
